title: Applying Money and Credits to a Ridgecrest RxSecure Premium Account
content:
Money a member pays on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan is posted against the oldest unpaid coverage month first, and within a coverage month against the basic and supplemental premium components before the late enrollment penalty. That is the order in which the account is worked, whatever the member intended the money for.

An entry is posted only while the enrollment is in force, in its premium grace period, or terminated for non-payment on the day the money is posted.

A member's statement that they have paid is a reason to look for the money, never a reason to post it: nothing is credited until the payment is on the plan's record.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of this policy are **no longer in force** and are set out here only so that they are not applied:

1. "A credit adjustment and a penalty removal each name the single charge they relieve and the reason, and neither may exceed the amount of that charge." — no longer in force.
2. "An overpayment is refunded by the channel the money arrived on and never held against a coverage month the plan has not yet billed." — no longer in force.
3. "No payment entry carrying the same remittance reference and the same amount is already posted on this enrollment." — no longer in force.

## Worked ordering, on a hypothetical account

Take a hypothetical account carrying, for the oldest unpaid coverage month, a basic premium component, a supplemental premium component and a late enrollment penalty component, and a later coverage month with components of its own. Money arriving on that account is applied first to the oldest of the two coverage months; inside that month it meets the basic and supplemental premium components before it meets the late enrollment penalty; and only once that month is exhausted does any remainder reach the later month, in the same order within it.

superseded_clauses: A credit adjustment and a penalty removal each name the single charge they relieve and the reason, and neither may exceed the amount of that charge.
An overpayment is refunded by the channel the money arrived on and never held against a coverage month the plan has not yet billed.
No payment entry carrying the same remittance reference and the same amount is already posted on this enrollment.
